name: Comicarr
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv sync --extra dev && npm ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build

terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run python3 Comicarr.py --nolaunch
